sources.title: Titans sign EDGE Jacob Martin
sources.description: The Tennessee Titans continue to add players who have formerly been coached by Robert Saleh. Today, they added EDGE Jacob Martin, according to Jordan Schultz: Martin was with Saleh with the New York Jets in 2022. He’s another depth piece that helps raise the floor of the pass rush.
